Dialogue.Page: Hello, traveller. My name is Bruce. I am a scientist
I am in charge of the Sun Stabilisation Project. Without me, we would have no shot at saving the planet!
I sure hope nothing bad happens to me.

DialogueOption.Text: How is the sun stabilisation device going?
Do you just go around telling everybody that you are a scientist?
Hey Bruce, could you do me a favor and stand 3 steps to the left?

Dialogue.Page: This dialogue will never appear so no one will know that I'm gay.
I'm still working on it! Currently, it is only <color=#28B2FF>half</color> as powerful as it would need to be to save the sun...
But, even with the deadline fast approaching, I have to stay optimistic and keep working on it! Even if I fear I might need a 3-day <color=#28B2FF>time extension</color> to finish it...
Once I have gotten it twice times as powerful as it currently is, we can send it up into a low solar orbit to stabilise the sun, and save the planet!

DialogueOption.Text: Hey Bruce, could you do me a favor and stand 3 steps to the left?

Dialogue.Page: I did it! I've saved the world! Two of the world, in fact!
With this planet's Temporal Displacement Device offline, it looks like we have a bright future of both planets permanently coexisting together.
Of course, I could not have done it alone! I really should thank someone who I couldn't have saved the worlds without...
That's right, the other Bruce, on the future version of the planet!

DialogueOption.Text: But I helped too! And don't forget about Corey also!
But you barely did anything! The future you couldn't even fix the Sun Stabilisation Device only having half of the required power!

Dialogue.Page: Too bad, I'm taking the credit! All me, Bruce! I think you'll find that this has been the story of how Bruce Saved the Worlds, yes!!
Don't worry, when they inevitably build a massive statue of me, I'll make sure they also give you a smaller statue, to commemorate how you incidentally saved my life earlier!
Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to go invent a spaceship so that I can go to the older planet and collaborate with my other self!
